body.value: 藩制一覽表第九（三日月、峰山）
藩制一覧表 第九冊（三日月・峰山）— 版面外側の柱書（はんせいいちらんひょう だいきゅうさつ）

Running header in the outer margin: Domain Survey Table, ninth fascicle (Mikazuki, Mineyama). The nine 藩制一覽表 fascicles are numbered registers of the 1869-70 Dajōkan survey rather than thematic volumes, and fascicles eight and nine carry the officials roster and the troop return. The header names Mikazuki and Mineyama because both entries open on this leaf at their maru-markers. It is provenance for the leaf and does not govern the 外ニ役員七十三人 column at the far right, which stands to the right of the ○三日月藩 marker and therefore belongs to Mibu, the preceding domain.
柱藩制一覽表第九三日月峰山（なし（版面事項）分）
四百四十七
四百四十七（447）

Printed folio number 447 in the outer margin, set 四 / 百 / 四 / 十 / 七 stacked. The fourth glyph is 十, a plain cross with no slanted stroke riding on top, so it is not 千. I rendered the source spread to check the sequence: the facing recto (lower_p235_right) prints 四百四十六 (446) and the next leaf (lower_p236_right) prints 四百四十八 (448), which confirms both the number and the reading order across the spread. Page furniture belonging to the leaf, not to either domain printed on it.
丁付四百四十七（なし（版面事項）分）
外ニ役員七十三人
外に役員七十三人（ほかに やくいん しちじゅうさんにん）

Besides the foregoing, staff and officers: 73 persons. This is the tail of the preceding domain's return, not Mikazuki's: it stands to the RIGHT of the ○三日月藩 marker, and in fascicles eight and nine a domain's military block prints after its officials and runs on past the next domain's marker. The facing recto (folio 446, headed 藩制一覽表第九（壬生）) carries the ○壬生藩 marker and Mibu's troop block — 兵隊十二小隊（但一隊三十人）, 合三百六十人（四隊但一隊九十人）, and 遊兵隊二十八人 — which this 73-man officer and staff supplement completes. The numeral is 七十三: 七 with its curved second stroke, then a plain 十, then 三 as three separate horizontals.
壬生外ニ役員七十三人
○三日月藩
○三日月藩（みかづきはん）

Domain-boundary marker: circle plus 三日月藩, Mikazuki domain (Mori house, Harima province, 15,000 koku). It opens Mikazuki's fascicle-nine entry. Everything to its RIGHT on this leaf — the 外ニ役員七十三人 column — is the preceding domain, Mibu; everything to its LEFT down to the ○峰山藩 marker is Mikazuki's own: four councillor grades, nine named appointees, and a three-platoon troop return.
三日月藩マル記號
大參事　二人
大参事（だいさんじ）二人

Senior Councillor (daisanji): 2 persons. The numeral is 二, two separate horizontal strokes, and the following glyph is 人, whose strokes meet at the apex. The two appointees hang directly below in this same column — 今村叉右衞門 in the upper name register and 平井代次郎 in the lower — so the printed figure and the names agree. Mikazuki's, the first grade listed after the ○三日月藩 marker.
三日月大參事
三人
三人（さんにん）— 權大參事欄の右傍に小字で組まれた訂正数

A side-note reading 三人 (3 persons), set in reduced type and placed immediately to the right of the 權大參事 column, which is where a vertical side-note attaches to the column it corrects. Its 人 measures 47 px wide by 43 px tall against 60-70 by 58-59 px for the full-size 人 in the counts on either side, and the whole run is only 47 px across where a full column is 61-63. It supplies the number that the printed 一人 does not: three men are actually named under 權大參事 on this leaf — 竹田權左衞門, 船曳孝 and 可兒勇之進. An ink projection down the narrow run x2276-2322 over the whole height of the page finds these two glyphs and nothing else, no office heading anywhere, which is what rules out reading it as a count of its own.
三日月權大參事傍記三人
今村叉右衞門
今村叉右衛門（いまむら またえもん）

Imamura Matauemon, the first of the two Senior Councillors, in the upper name register of the 大參事 column. Six glyphs: 今 / 村 / 叉 / 右 / 衞 / 門. The fourth is 右 rather than 石 — it follows 叉 and not a numeral, and the mouth element sits under a full left-falling stroke. Mikazuki's.
三日月大參事一人目今村叉右衞門
平井代次郎
平井代次郎（ひらい だいじろう）

Hirai Daijirō, the second Senior Councillor, in the lower name register of the same column. Five glyphs: 平 / 井 / 代 / 次 / 郎. With Imamura Matauemon above he completes the 二人 printed under the heading. Mikazuki's.
三日月大參事二人目平井代次郎
權大參事　一人
権大参事（ごんだいさんじ）一人

Provisional Senior Councillor (gon-daisanji): 1 person as printed. The numeral is a single horizontal stroke, 一, not 二 or 三. The figure does not match the roster: three men are named under this heading (竹田權左衞門 and 船曳孝 in this column, 可兒勇之進 in the column to its left), and the compiler's reduced-type 三人 stands in the margin immediately to the right of this column to say so. Mikazuki's.
三日月權大參事
竹田權左衞門
竹田権左衛門（たけだ ごんざえもん）
Takeda Gonzaemon, the first Provisional Senior Councillor, in the upper name register of the 權大參事 column. Six glyphs: 竹 / 田 / 權 / 左 / 衞 / 門. Mikazuki's.
三日月權大參事一人目竹田權左衞門
船曳孝
船曳孝（ふなびき たかし）

Funabiki Takashi, the second Provisional Senior Councillor, in the lower name register of the same column. Only three glyphs — 船 / 曳 / 孝 — and they are spaced out across the full depth of the name cell (船 at y2939-2998, 曳 at y3140-3202, 孝 at y3442-3501), which is the printer's way of filling a cell sized for five or six characters. The wide gaps are not missing glyphs. Mikazuki's.
三日月權大參事二人目船曳孝
可兒勇之進
可児勇之進（かに ゆうのしん）

Kani Yūnoshin, the third Provisional Senior Councillor. His column carries no office heading of its own, which is how the register continues a list that has outrun its heading column: names run leftward from the heading they belong to, and the next heading (少參事) stands further left again. He is the man the marginal 三人 note accounts for. Mikazuki's.
三日月權大參事三人目可兒勇之進
少參事　二人（マヽ）
少参事（しょうさんじ）二人（マヽ＝ママ、原文のまま）

Junior Councillor (shōsanji): 2 persons. A parenthesised sic mark stands immediately to the right of the numeral in its own narrow run at x2004-2041, and it is built from four separate stacked marks: an opening arc (y1404-1420), a wedge-shaped マ with a flat top narrowing to a point (y1429-1448), a comma-shaped ヽ (y1466-1483), and a closing arc (y1489-1507). Read together they are （マヽ）, the compilers' ママ, 'thus in the original'. Only one Junior Councillor is in fact named, 山田孫兵衞 directly below in this same column, and the next column to the left opens the 權少參事 grade, so the roster falls one short of the printed figure — which is what the mark flags. The box takes in the heading, the numeral and the sic mark together because the mark is squeezed against this column and shares its footprint. Mikazuki's.
三日月少參事
山田孫兵衞
山田孫兵衛（やまだ まごべえ）

Yamada Magobee, the only Junior Councillor named on this leaf. Five glyphs: 山 / 田 / 孫 / 兵 / 衞. The lower name register of this column is blank, and the next column to the left opens the 權少參事 grade, so the roster stops at one man against the printed 二人 — the discrepancy the （マヽ）mark records. Mikazuki's.
三日月少參事山田孫兵衞
權少參事
権少参事（ごんしょうさんじ）— 人数の記載なし

Provisional Junior Councillor (gon-shōsanji). No numeral prints beneath the heading: an ink projection down the whole column finds glyphs only at the heading (y1007-1322) and in the two name registers, with nothing in the y-band 1430-1580 where every other count on this leaf sits. Three appointees follow — 岡村小左衞門 and 百々半左衞門 in this column, 岸平助 in the next one left — so the effective count is three. A 權少參事 heading printed with no numeral under it recurs elsewhere in this fascicle (folio 404 carries one), so the blank is a habit of the register rather than damage to this leaf. Mikazuki's.
三日月權少參事
岡村小左衞門
岡村小左衛門（おかむら こざえもん）
Okamura Kozaemon, the first Provisional Junior Councillor, in the upper name register under the 權少參事 heading. Six glyphs: 岡 / 村 / 小 / 左 / 衞 / 門. Mikazuki's.
三日月權少參事一人目岡村小左衞門
百々半左衞門
百々半左衛門（どど はんざえもん）

Dodo Hanzaemon, the second Provisional Junior Councillor, in the lower name register of the same column. Six glyphs: 百 / 々 / 半 / 左 / 衞 / 門, the second being the iteration mark that doubles 百. Mikazuki's.
三日月權少參事二人目百々半左衞門
岸平助
岸平助（きし へいすけ）

Kishi Heisuke, the third Provisional Junior Councillor and the last of Mikazuki's nine named officials. Three glyphs — 岸 / 平 / 助 — spaced across the full depth of the name cell (岸 at y2026-2086, 平 at y2330-2387, 助 at y2532-2591). The column carries no heading of its own; it continues the 權少參事 list. Mikazuki's.
三日月權少參事三人目岸平助
兵隊　三小隊　一小隊役員ノ外大略二十伍ヲ以テ定規トナス
兵隊（へいたい）三小隊。一小隊、役員の外、大略二十五を以て定規となす。

Troops: three platoons. The double-column note beneath is set in half-size type and reads across its two sub-columns — right first (一小隊役員ノ外大略二), then left (十伍ヲ以テ定規トナス) — giving "one platoon, apart from its officers, is fixed at roughly twenty-five men." The numeral splits across the two sub-columns, 二 ending the right and 十伍 opening the left, which confirms the reading order. 伍 is the formal five, so the standard is 25 and three platoons come to about 75 men, exclusive of officers. The heading numeral is 三, three separate horizontal strokes, not 五. This column stands to the RIGHT of the ○峰山藩 marker and is therefore Mikazuki's, not Mineyama's: a domain's troop return prints after its officials and can overrun the next domain's marker.
三日月兵隊
○峰山藩
○峰山藩（みねやまはん）

Domain-boundary marker: circle plus 峰山藩, Mineyama domain (Kyōgoku house, Tango province, roughly 11,000 koku). It opens Mineyama's fascicle-nine entry. Everything to its RIGHT — including the three-platoon troop return — closes Mikazuki; everything to its LEFT is Mineyama's. The register prints the name 峰山藩 here and in the running header; the project's MASTER dataset files this domain under the variant 峯山藩.
峰山藩マル記號
大參事　一人
大参事（だいさんじ）一人

Senior Councillor (daisanji): 1 person. A single horizontal stroke, 一. The one appointee, 三上宗左衞門, hangs directly below in this column, so figure and roster agree. Mineyama's, the first grade after the ○峰山藩 marker.
峰山大參事
三上宗左衞門
三上宗左衛門（みかみ そうざえもん）
Mikami Sōzaemon, Mineyama's sole Senior Councillor. Six glyphs: 三 / 上 / 宗 / 左 / 衞 / 門. The lower name register of this column is blank, matching the printed 一人.
峰山大參事三上宗左衞門
權大參事　二人（五人）
権大参事（ごんだいさんじ）二人（五人）

Provisional Senior Councillor (gon-daisanji): 2 persons, with 五人 (5 persons) set below in vertical parentheses — the opening arc at y1573-1587 and the closing arc at y1711-1728 both print, so this is a bracketed second figure inside the column and not a separate count. Four men are named under the heading on this leaf: 今井多門 and 高木內藏進 in the next column, 佐藤榮 and 辻八太郎 in the one after. Mineyama's roster then resumes on folio 448, where the first heading is 少參事二人, so no fifth Provisional Senior Councillor follows. Neither printed figure matches the four names; the parenthetical 5 does match the total of all officials named for Mineyama on this leaf (one 大參事 plus four), which may be what the compiler was counting.
峰山權大參事
今井多門
今井多門（いまい たもん）
Imai Tamon, the first Provisional Senior Councillor of Mineyama, in the upper name register. Four glyphs — 今 / 井 / 多 / 門 — spread across a cell sized for six.
峰山權大參事一人目今井多門
高木內藏進
高木内蔵進（たかぎ くらのしん）
Takagi Kuranoshin, the second Provisional Senior Councillor, in the lower name register of the same column. Five glyphs: 高 / 木 / 內 / 藏 / 進, with the kyūjitai forms 內 and 藏. Mineyama's.
峰山權大參事二人目高木內藏進
佐藤榮
佐藤栄（さとう さかえ）

Satō Sakae, the third Provisional Senior Councillor. Three glyphs — 佐 / 藤 / 榮 — spaced across the full cell (佐 at y2014-2076, 藤 at y2220-2278, 榮 at y2517-2581). This column carries no heading; it continues the 權大參事 list. Mineyama's.
峰山權大參事三人目佐藤榮
辻八太郎
辻八太郎（つじ はちたろう）

Tsuji Hachitarō, the fourth Provisional Senior Councillor and the last name printed on this leaf. Four glyphs: 辻 / 八 / 太 / 郎. The second is 八, whose two strokes stay apart at the top and splay outward, not 人, whose strokes meet at the apex. This is the leftmost data column; the running header and folio number stand beyond it in the margin. Mineyama's.
峰山權大參事四人目辻八太郎
